items.title: 17.8 Uses of Group 2 Elements and Compounds (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.8, printed page 10.

blocks.text: Group 2 compounds ke industry (sanat), rozmarra zindagi, medicine (dawa) aur agriculture (zaraat) mein bohat se istemal hain. Is ki bari wajah in ka basic nature aur in ki alag alag solubility hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si do khoobiyan Group 2 compounds ko itna useful (mufeed) banati hain?
blocks.explanation: In ka basic nature (acid ko khatam karna) aur in ki alag alag solubility (koi zyada ghulta hai, koi bilkul nahi).

items: Group 2 compounds ke istemal in ke basic nature aur solubility par depend karte hain.
